exec("import os
import sys
import coverage
import pytest
import tomllib

with open(sys.argv[4], "rb") as stream:
    control = tomllib.load(stream)
selectors = control.get("selectors")
enabled = [item.get("id") for item in control.get("rules", [])]
if (
    selectors != {"RUNTIME_TEST_FAILURE": "factory_runtime_failure"}
    or len(enabled) > 1
    or any(rule not in selectors for rule in enabled)
):
    raise ValueError("invalid pinned runtime controls")

class RuntimeRuleFilter:
    def pytest_collection_modifyitems(self, session, config, items):
        disabled = {
            marker for rule, marker in selectors.items() if rule not in enabled
        }
        keep = []
        deselected = []
        for item in items:
            markers = {marker.name for marker in item.iter_markers()}
            (deselected if markers.intersection(disabled) else keep).append(item)
        items[:] = keep
        config.hook.pytest_deselected(items=deselected)

cov = coverage.Coverage(
    branch=True, data_file=sys.argv[2], config_file=False, source=[sys.argv[1]]
)
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
cov.start()
try:
    code = pytest.main(
        [
            sys.argv[1] + "/tests",
            "--junitxml=" + sys.argv[3],
            "-o",
            "junit_family=xunit1",
            "-o",
            "markers=factory_runtime_failure: runtime detector control",
            "-p",
            "no:cacheprovider",
        ],
        plugins=[RuntimeRuleFilter()],
    )
finally:
    cov.stop()
    cov.save()
    cov.json_report(
        outfile=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(sys.argv[3]), "coverage.json")
    )
sys.exit(code)
")
